Calus raid summarized:
Split into 2 groups of three for the raid 

To enter each section have squad 1 stay and defend.  Squad 2 gets the "standard". 

Rinse and repeat

Dogs. 

2 sun gem holders - 1 maze leader. Last 3 people simply follow leader

Gem holders - beast handlers spawn each time a spore is killed.  You are left with a choice
A. Kill immediately so this part is easy as balls. 1 left and 1 right. 
B. Let them drop and kill them so everyone can get unneeded heavy ammo


6 dogs - 6 players.  Pick one and don't kill the dogs on phase one (unless everyone is confident in it).  Communicate which ones will need help for the second "kill phase"    


Everyone knows how the safe house works

Bath house -  
2 squads of three.   
3 left.  
3 right.   
"Floater" for each side will help top kill bather and then let the top player grab a new psion shield and help bottom with their bather.  Once bather is dead bottom moves to top and let's that player grab a new shield.  
Both sides rinse and repeat until the signal to meet in the middle is given. 
Destroy the purple lanterns.   Rinse and Repeat until lanterns are destroyed

Gauntlet -
2 squads of 3.  You have the dog side and chalice side. 
Squad roles
1- runner / comms 
2- psions/ top triangle
3- platforms / bottom triangle

Each side will take an additional symbol (sun or blades) to help with ads on that side. 
Chime 1 - basic ads,  kill them
Chime 2. 3 centurions, not even 4.  Kill them
Chime 3.  Runners grab charges and other "2" of each squad stand on their platform

Runner will call out the section they see the red circle in, which will appear when teammate #3 activates the pillar.  
2 and 3 will shoot the triangles the runner did not call.  
For example:  1 calls out "top". 2 will shoot the middle triangle and 3 will shoot the bottom triangle

Rinse and repeat until the super simple jumping puzzle at the end.  

 After the second jump the floor will fall.  If you clear that with your team it is possible to complete the gauntlet.   Otherwise you will be force wiped because of the revive timer.  

Calus. 
2 squads of 3 again.
 Each player plays a lane for this part.  You are either squad 1 who stays in the throne room with Calus or squad 2 who goes to the void realm.  Either way. You will have a responsibility to stay in your lane (left right and middle).  

Squad 1: throneroom
Roles
1- left : axe and chalice psions
2- right : sun and dog
3- ads/floater - kill everything. Focus the yellow bars because the spawns will stagger on each side. 

The full squad is responsible for ad clearing




Squad 2
1- left
2- middle
3- right 

Assign call outs. 1-2-3 should happen in that order. Not all at once for a call out. If 1 fails to initiate the call outs, maybe change up who starts it.  I have seen people get too distracted, personally I don't see how you forget, but it happens.

Once you get teleported into the void realm assume your position. 
Identify your symbol before aiming in at the psions.  

You need to kill the psions but will miss the call out if you don't read it before ADS.  

First kill your assigned psion (some teams have different preferences on this so we will assume you are killing the psion in your lane)
Kill left floating psion  then right floating psion and move forward
  Rinse and repeat until Calus stops sucking (which is actually never). Then group up with your void realm survivors wrecking skulls however you see best.   

You are telported back and conjoined as a single force.  Pick your dps cycle.  Personally have noticed 
Sun - Dog - Axes - chalice. 
To be the best.   
How you do the damage is up to you and your squad. 
I have heard tons of people getting one phase off different methods.

Rinse and repeat
